form.label: JFrog Platform - SOC Overview
form.description: Ingestion health, Artifactory request/access activity, security audit events, Artifactory traffic, router requests, narrow Distribution request/access records, and narrowly evidenced Xray request/service/webhook records for JFrog Platform sourcetypes. Not field-validated: panels are conservative and based on synthetic-equivalent fixture evidence only. All sourcetypes require a dedicated syslog listener (port 20070) with JFROG_PLATFORM source tag.

search.query: index=main vendor="jfrog" product="platform" host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:request" (status>=400 OR http_status>=400) host=$host_tok$ | stats count

index=main sourcetype IN ("jfrog:artifactory:request","jfrog:artifactory:access","jfrog:distribution:request","jfrog:distribution:access","jfrog:access:security_audit") user=* NOT user="anonymous" host=$host_tok$ | stats dc(user) AS unique_users
index=main vendor="jfrog" product="platform" host=$host_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype

panel.title: Security audit - admin and token events

search.query: index=main sourcetype="jfrog:access:security_audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval who=coalesce(user, "unknown") | table _time host who src_ip logged_principal entity_name event_type event data_changed | sort -_time | head 100
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:access" host=$host_tok$ | eval who=coalesce(user, "unknown") | table _time host who src_ip action_response repo_path trace_id | sort -_time | head 100
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:access" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by user, repo_path | sort -count | head 50

panel.title: Artifactory request status (errors visible when present)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:request" host=$host_tok$ | eval http_stat=coalesce(status, http_status), error_flag=if(http_stat>=400,"error","non_error") | table _time host user src_ip http_method url http_stat error_flag duration_ms user_agent | sort -_time | head 100
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:traffic" host=$host_tok$ | stats count, sum(transfer_bytes) AS total_bytes by traffic_direction | sort -total_bytes
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:request" http_method=GET host=$host_tok$ | stats count, sum(response_size) AS total_bytes by user, src_ip | sort -count | head 30
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:traffic" host=$host_tok$ | stats count, sum(transfer_bytes) AS total_bytes by traffic_direction, repo_path, src_ip | sort -total_bytes | head 50

panel.title: Router request status (errors visible when present)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="jfrog:router:request" host=$host_tok$ | eval http_stat=coalesce(status, http_status), error_flag=if(http_stat>=400,"error","non_error") | table _time host src_ip remote_addr request_method request_url http_stat error_flag trace_id | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype IN ("jfrog:artifactory:request","jfrog:distribution:request","jfrog:xray:request") http_method IN (PUT, POST) host=$host_tok$ | stats count, sum(request_size) AS total_bytes by sourcetype, user, src_ip, http_method | sort -count | head 30

index=main sourcetype IN ("jfrog:distribution:request","jfrog:distribution:access") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype user src_ip action_response http_method url status repo_path trace_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype IN ("jfrog:xray:request","jfrog:xray:service","jfrog:xray:webhook") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype jfrog_log_family trace_id alert_id top_severity severity policy_name policy_rule watch_name user src_ip http_method url status xray_service message marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: SPL for manual triage (copy and run)
panel.html:
All JFrog events drilldown:
index=main vendor="jfrog" product="platform" | table _time sourcetype host user src_ip action signature traffic_direction transfer_bytes event_type alert_id top_severity policy_name policy_rule _raw

Security audit - unusual token activity:
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:access:security_audit" event_type="token" | stats count by user, event, entity_name | sort -count

Distribution request/access review:
index=main sourcetype IN ("jfrog:distribution:request","jfrog:distribution:access") | table _time user src_ip http_method url status action_response repo_path trace_id

Xray webhook alerts by severity:
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:xray:webhook" | stats count by top_severity, policy_name, policy_rule, watch_name | sort -count

Slow Artifactory requests (>5000ms):
index=main sourcetype="jfrog:artifactory:request" | where duration_ms>5000 | table _time user src_ip http_method url status duration_ms

NOTE: All sourcetypes require a dedicated listener on port 20070 with JFROG_PLATFORM source tag in SC4S.

Note: panels use synthetic-equivalent fixture evidence; not field-validated on live JFrog Platform sources.
